purpose: Map internal uncertainty signals into natural buyer-facing clarification language.
rules: Never speak classifier or confidence language.
Never say: I am not confident enough to classify this.
Never say semantic, schema, intent classifier, verifier, policy, or route in buyer-facing say.
Low confidence must become a natural clarification.
Clarification should preserve buyer wording and ask one useful question.
forbidden_buyer_facing_terms: I am not confident enough to classify this

mappings.buyer_facing: Just so I answer the right thing - are you asking what the plans are, or which one fits you?
I heard something like Claude there - are you comparing ChatGPT with Claude, or did I catch that wrong?
What would you mainly use it for - work, coding, writing, research, voice, or something else?
Let me use what you already said instead of asking again.
Sounds good. Start from the official ChatGPT plans page, and if you are unsure, start lower and move up only if you need more headroom.
